'''Athok Dinvar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he resided in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], along with his boss, [[Kritus Morven]].<ref name="SWG:AD" /> The latter has a strong rivalry with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]].<ref name="SWG:KM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kritus Morven|Naboo}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Dinvar hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to carry several illegal tasks, leading to numerous fights with [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|Borvo's henchmen]] and the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. These missions included the killing of one of Borvo's thug to recover [[Spice/Legends|spice]] belonging to "Mr. Morven", escorting a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who was attacked by Borvo's men and protecting a thug named thug [[Turnik'otta]] against RSF security guards.<ref name="SWG:AD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Athok Dinvar was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Athok Dinvar could be found in the city of Keren on Naboo where he originally gave four completable missions to players. However, these quests were bugged and lacked any text dialogue strings, rendering it impossible to have derived much context from them.<ref name="SWG:AD" /><ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=76216.html|text=Has Anyone Completed All the Working Static Quests?}} {{C|"username/password: swganh"}}</ref> For this reason, these quests were deactivated by the developers relatively early in the game's lifespan. Athok Dinvar remained in Keren, but would only tell players who interacted with him that he did not have time for them.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=game_guides&message.id=148427|text=Quests NPC all around SWG World - March 2004}}</ref>
